title: Python requirement declared with no version constraint
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement line with no version specifier. The installer takes whatever the index serves at build time, so a release published after review installs without a manifest change.
remediation: Pin the version the project tested, and let a deliberate upgrade change the pin.
limitation: It matches a requirement line with no version specifier in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
